verdict.rationale: The evidence shows FFmpeg's source is publicly readable in the official GitHub repository (FFmpeg/FFmpeg), including its library structure and a doc/examples directory. Community users also report reading ffplay's source to learn the API. However, nothing in the pack states the license terms, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the open-source license (e.g. LGPL/GPL terms), first-party statement on source availability and licensing.
